meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: Withdrawing live RFQ succeeds when a valid reason is entered

plan.title: Withdraw Live RFQ with Valid Reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event with a vendor bid.
Open the RFQ stage as required by the scenario.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab before opening Settings.
Withdraw the RFQ stage using the valid reason and confirm the action.
Assert that the RFQ is shown as withdrawn.
